answer: A harbor pays agents to inspect crystal cargo as it moves down a spiral conveyor. Only the port authority can issue a signed work order, one per container and shift. The contract checks the issuer signature, the assigned agent and the authority's signed completion receipt, then marks the order paid. A copied receipt earns nothing under another name. To collect 100 payouts, a Sybil operator has to win and carry out 100 separate inspections, spending staff time and equipment capacity on each.
